title: Energising Revive - Pictos Effect & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Energising Revive in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - what this Pictos does and exactly where to find it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Energising Revive is a Pictos in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Effect: +3 AP to all allies when you are revived.

sections.title: Effect
sections.content: +3 AP to all allies when you are revived.

sections.title: Is It Worth Equipping?
sections.content: Pictos unlock a Lumina after four battles, so equipping it once is enough to keep the effect permanently available for the Lumina cost.
